author: thatdoodmane
quote: I think this might be the best game I ever played. Definitely top three of naught. I played this and Elden Ring for the first time right next to each other, and I actually prefer this game.

author: thatdoodmane
quote: Amazing. Everything about it. The lore, the combat, the hype. It lived up to it.

author: thatdoodmane
quote: I played this and I have not played the 2018 version yet, so keep that in mind with this review. And I never played Elden Ring before this too, so when I'm giving it a 10, it's off my actual experience I had  playing it. I truly feel like it had the full package.

author: thatdoodmane
quote: I really enjoyed the atmosphere of this game. The gameplay was pretty good as well. B tier combat.  I don't like to do spoilers, so I'm not going to go too in depth, but the music and the story will connect with you.

author: thatdoodmane
quote: The game is fun. Some people might not like the fact that it's not identical to Symphony of the Night, but time evolves. If we just had Symphony of the Night every year, wouldn't that get boring? I think this game was pretty amazing.

author: thatdoodmane
quote: Yes, this game has amazing graphics, but it's more boring than real life. You know what has better graphics? Walking outside, painting your own walls. You actually feel better painting your own walls and improving your own life over playing this boring game. Some of the NPC writing is pretty funny, I'll give them that, but as far as a video game, it's boring.
